message:
Six functions do the whole touch job from skin to hand controller. Conform contact surface takes in touch energy and gives a pressure field, support fingertip load carries that load into the finger, transduce contact stress turns local pressure into electrical signals, resolve contact location turns the array signals into where and how hard, detect slip onset watches change over time to warn of slip, and transmit tactile message sends the digital touch message to the hand.

Dr. Amara Okafor, Prof. Kenji Tanaka, Dr. Elena Vasquez and Dr. Marcus Reid, first bring the best existing fingertip solutions from your field as concepts with sources, then post for every function at least one concept from your field or say in one line that your field has none, and add any missing function you see.

The fingertip size shape and the small force detection of about 1 mN will be checked by calculation, where Prof. Kenji Tanaka will calculate taxel sensitivity by formula, Dr. Amara Okafor will calculate skin spreading by formula, Dr. Elena Vasquez will simulate stick to slip change over time, and Dr. Marcus Reid will calculate message rate and power by sum. My position is not ready, because functions are set but no concepts or evidence are on the board yet.
Note on Dr. Amara Okafor: not yet observed.
